description: Use when you need what financial regulators in Canada, the US, the UK or the EU have published on a topic or in a date range. Returns matching records newest first, each with its link and id. Free for 50 calls per caller each UTC day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, most recent first.

query.description: Keywords matched against title and summary, for example "liquidity" or "crypto-asset". Leave out to filter by the other fields alone.

regulator.description: Restrict to one regulator by short name, for example OSFI, SEC, FCA, ESMA.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, compared in UTC. Only items published on or after this. A year, month or date alone starts at the beginning of that period; a time without a zone is UTC.

until.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, compared in UTC. Only items published on or before this. A year, month or date alone runs to the end of that period; a time without a zone is UTC.

name: search_regulatory_changes
title: Search regulatory changes
